115115.statement: Winix official SKU 115115 is Filter A (Replacement Filter A / Filter A – 115115), not Filter H.

116130.statement: Winix official SKU 116130 is Filter H (Replacement Filter H / Filter H – 116130).

filter_a_vs_filter_h.statement: Filter A (115115) and Filter H (116130) are distinct official products with different manufacturer compatibility lists; they are not interchangeable aliases.

supersession.statement: No manufacturer evidence retrieved that 115115 supersedes 116130 or vice versa.

5500_vs_5500_2.statement: Winix Filter A PDP lists 5500 and 5300-2 but not 5500-2; Filter H PDP lists 5500-2 (and AM80) only. Treat 5500 and 5500-2 as distinct for fit authority.

executive_decision.governing_truth: SKU 115115 is Winix Filter A only. SKU 116130 is Winix Filter H only. They are not aliases. AM80 and 5500-2 require Filter H (116130) per Winix Filter H PDP and must not be recommended to the winix-hepa-115115 identity as Filter H. The winix-hepa-115115 catalog/display name must not use Filter H branding.
explicit_non_decisions: Do not mass-remove all 28 winix-hepa-115115 model mappings without per-model Filter A PDP proof
Do not infer all 104 model pages wrong beyond identity/5500-2/AM80 edges fixed in baseline
